theme: Sabbath Camp: God Looks at the Heart
summary: Sabbath Camp looks back at David's anointing, his harp, and his victory over Goliath. God looks at the heart, and He makes us brave.

story_reel.narration: Welcome to Sabbath Camp! What a week in the Shepherd's Hills. Let's remember. God sent Samuel to Bethlehem to anoint a new king. Seven tall, strong brothers passed by, but God said, 'Yahweh doesn't see the way people see. People look at the outside, but Yahweh looks at the heart.' God chose the youngest, a shepherd boy who wasn't even invited. David played his harp, and it brought peace to troubled King Saul. Then a giant named Goliath shouted at God's people for forty days. Everyone was afraid, but David saw how big God is. He took off Saul's armor, picked up five smooth stones, and said, 'The battle is Yahweh's!' One stone, and the giant fell. The whole army found courage. And David wrote songs about God being his rock. This week's big truth: Yahweh looks at your heart, and He makes you brave. You don't have to be the biggest, the oldest, or the strongest. God sees your heart, and He is with you.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, thank You for looking at my heart. Make my heart brave and full of love for You. I don't have to be the biggest, because You are with me. Amen.

companion.message: Realm 23 complete! After Goliath, I went to live in King Saul's palace, and I met someone who became my very best friend. You'll meet him next week!
